entries.title: Researchers are developing textiles that can produce drinking water from the air
entries.summary: How very Dune.
entries.excerpt: There are existing methods to collect water from the ambient air, but most of them are large or cumbersome. Recent research by the University of Texas at Austin is taking that concept and transforming it something you could have on hand at all times. Or more literally, on your back at all times. In a study published inScientific Advances, the team used a special textile to create a jacket capable of atmospheric water harvesting.
